name: Tm Visualization Suite
pitch: Ten Qlik Cloud visualization families that answer different analytical questions.
useWhen: Add a chart type that a native Qlik chart does not draw.
features: Install one family for each analytical question that you answer.
Change the mode of a family without a new data setup.
Read the current Qlik selection in every chart of the suite.
Select a Qlik value with the pointer, the keyboard, or touch.
Follow the light or the dark Qlik theme in text, colors, and surface.
Read one author guide for each family and one install guide.
